intro.title: Path Sum
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function to determine if a binary tree has a root-to-leaf path where the sum of node values equals a given target. You will learn the core concept of tree traversal using recursion to explore each possible path from the root to the leaves. The main technologies involved are JavaScript functions, conditional logic, and working with tree node objects. This beginner-friendly exercise will help you understand how to break down a problem by recursively checking subtrees and summing values along the way.
intro.usecase: The Path Sum algorithm is essential in file systems and organizational tools where hierarchical data structures are common. For example, when calculating the total size of a folder including all subfolders in a file explorer, or determining the total cost of a project including all nested sub-tasks in project management software. This pattern also appears in e-commerce platforms when calculating discounts that apply to entire category trees, or in UI components like nested menus where you need to track cumulative states. Understanding path sum traversal helps developers build efficient systems for financial calculations, resource allocation, and data aggregation across tree-like structures.
